headings: Our Technology, Infrastructure, Research and Development, and Operations
paragraphs: Docusign solutions bring agreements to life, accelerating and simplifying the process of doing business. Docusign's core offerings — our Intelligent Agreement Management ("IAM") platform, the world's leading e-signature solution, and contract lifecycle management ("CLM") solution — allow organizations to boost productivity, accelerate contract review cycles, and transform agreement data into insights and actions, while providing a customer-centric experience. The Docusign IAM platform is a system of record that enables customers of all sizes to ingest a vast, complex body of agreements into a single repository, build agreement workflows that operate at scale, and take action on high-accuracy insights from agreement data. As of January 31, 2026, over 1.8 million customers and more than a billion users worldwide utilize Docusign to accelerate and simplify the process of doing business, and more than 25,000 customers are on IAM today.

We offer subscriptions to our products to businesses of all sizes, from global enterprises down to very small businesses ("VSBs"). We offer more than 1,100 active partner integrations with the applications that many of our customers already use so that they can create, commit, and manage agreements directly within these applications. We have a diverse customer base spanning across virtually all industries and around the world with no significant customer concentration. No single customer accounted for more than 10% of total revenue in any of the periods presented.

We focused initially on selling our products to commercial businesses and VSBs and later expanded our focus to target enterprise customers. As of January 31, 2026, we had a total of over 1.8 million customers, including approximately 280,000 direct enterprise and commercial customers managed through our sales force and partner channels, compared to nearly 1.7 million customers and over 260,000 direct enterprise and commercial customers as of January 31, 2025. We define a customer as a separate and distinct buying entity, such as a company, an educational or government institution, or a distinct business unit of a large company that has an active contract to access our products. The number of our customers with greater than $300,000 in annualized contract value was 1,205 as of January 31, 2026, compared to 1,131 as of January 31, 2025. Each of our customer types has a different purchasing pattern. VSBs typically become customers by quickly utilizing our digital and self-serve channels and generate smaller average contract values, while commercial and enterprise customers typically involve longer sales cycles, larger contract values, and greater expansion opportunities for us.

We generate substantially all our revenue from sales of subscriptions, which accounted for 98% of our revenue in the year ended January 31, 2026 and 97% of our revenue in the year ended January 31, 2025. Our subscription fees are primarily comprised of fees from customers using our products and access to customer support. Subscriptions generally range from one to three years, and substantially all our multi-year customers pay in annual installments, one year in advance.

We also generate revenue from professional and other non-subscription services, which consists primarily of fees associated with providing new customers with deployment and integration services. Professional services and other revenue accounted for the remainder of total revenue in each of the years ended January 31, 2026 and 2025.

Historically, we offered access to most of our products on a subscription basis with prices based on the functionality and the quantity of Envelopes required by our customers. Similar to the physical envelopes historically used to mail paper documents, an Envelope is a digital container used to send one or more documents for signature or approval to one or more recipients. Our customers have the flexibility to put a large number of documents in an Envelope. For several use cases, such as buying a home, multiple Envelopes are used over the course of the process. To drive customer reach and adoption, we also offer certain limited-time or feature-constrained versions of our e-signature solution for free.

In the second quarter of fiscal 2025, we began offering our IAM platform on a user-based subscription basis in specific customer segments and geographies, through our direct sales channel, and in fiscal 2026, we made IAM available across all major geographies where we do business. Our IAM subscription offerings have multiple pricing tiers as well as specialized packages for specific user personas, customer verticals and segments, and departments within an organization. While IAM subscriptions include our core products and solutions, like eSignature, we expect standalone eSignature to continue to represent the majority of our revenue for the foreseeable future given IAM's early growth phase. For the year ended January 31, 2026, customers using IAM represented approximately 10.8% of our annual recurring revenue.
We believe that our market opportunity is large, and we plan to invest to support long-term growth based on the three pillars of our long-term strategy:

The first pillar is to accelerate product innovation through research and development investments, helping our IAM platform address our customers' agreement management needs comprehensively. We aim to deliver category-leading value in the agreement management market while evolving into a platform company.

◦IAM: In April 2024, we announced the launch of the IAM platform at our annual Momentum customer conference. We rapidly innovated the platform from ideation to launch, leveraging customer feedback. As a platform, IAM includes our industry-leading eSignature product as a core capability and is powered by Docusign Iris, our AI engine. Other capabilities include Navigator, our AI-powered agreement repository that helps customers manage and identify insights from their agreements, and Maestro, our no-code workflow builder that helps customers accelerate agreement processes. Additional AI-powered tools, including Agreement Desk, AI-Assisted Review, and AI contract agents, streamline agreement creation and management.

◦Developer Ecosystem: Part of our evolution into a platform company requires supporting a dynamic community of developers and partners to create new solutions that extend the capabilities of our IAM platform. In November 2024, we hosted Docusign Discover, our first-ever developer-focused conference, and launched Docusign for Developers, giving our partners tools to build apps powered by the IAM platform. Partners can share their apps in the Docusign App Center, adding to the over 1,100 active partner integrations with Docusign products.

◦eSignature and CLM: With a renewed focus on product innovation, these products have seen improved innovation delivery, as a result of our investment in our IAM platform, which brings more AI-powered capabilities across the greater Docusign product portfolio.

◦Core Value Propositions: Docusign is building IAM on the foundation created by our existing customer value propositions and benefits, including eSignature user simplicity, which has generated over 775,000 Apple App Store ratings with an average score of 4.9 out of 5; global footprint and adoption by customers in many jurisdictions that require different legal requirements to complete valid agreements; highly auditable agreements and signatures; stringent security certification standards; and scaled infrastructure that enables delivery of eSignature at over 99.9% availability worldwide.

headings: Risks Related to our Common Stock

If our IAM platform, products and solutions do not evolve to meet the needs of our customers or fail to achieve sufficient market acceptance, our financial results and competitive position will suffer.
Rapid and unpredictable advances in AI and other technologies could reduce demand for our solutions, disrupt our business and strategy, and cause competitive and financial harm.
If we are unable to deliver excellent service and support to customers, retain and expand sales to existing customers, and attract new customers, our revenue growth will be adversely affected.
The market in which we participate is evolving and highly competitive, which may negatively affect our ability to add new customers, retain existing customers and grow our business.
If we have overestimated our market opportunity, our future growth rate may be limited.
We use AI in our business, and challenges with properly governing its use could result in reputational harm, competitive harm, and legal liability, and adversely affect our results of operations.
We rely on the performance of highly skilled personnel, including our management and other key employees, and failing to attract, integrate, or retain such employees could harm our business.
Our sales to government entities and highly regulated organizations are subject to a number of challenges and risks.
If we are unable to maintain successful relationships with our partners, our business, operating results and financial condition could be harmed.
Failure to establish and maintain relationships with partners that can provide complementary technology offerings and software integrations could limit our ability to grow our business.

Failure to effectively develop and expand our marketing and sales capabilities could harm our ability to increase our customer base and achieve broader market acceptance of our products and solutions.
We may need to reduce or change our pricing model to remain competitive.
We may not be able to scale our business quickly enough to meet the growing needs of our customers and if we are not able to grow efficiently, our operating results could be harmed.
paragraphs: These summary risks provide an overview of many of the risks we are exposed to in the normal course of our business. As a result, the following summary risks do not contain all the information that may be important to you, and you should read them together with the more detailed discussion of risks set forth following this section under the heading "Risk Factors," and with the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Additional risks beyond those discussed below in "Risk Factors" or elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K that we do not currently anticipate or that we currently deem immaterial could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition or prospects, and could cause the trading price of our common stock to decline.
These risks include, but are not limited to, the following:
•Any decrease in adoption or sales of our eSignature product, without corresponding adoption or sales of our other solutions in our IAM platform.
•Our IAM platform failing to achieve market acceptance or to meet our customers' evolving needs.
•Disruptions to our business, strategy and demand for our solutions due to advances in, and uses of, AI and other technologies.
•Any inability to deliver excellent service and support to customers, retain and expand sales to existing customers, and attract new customers.

headings: 本公司成長與投資策略
本公司科技、基礎建設、研究與發展以及營運
paragraphs: Docusign 解決方案讓協議具體化，加速並簡化商業流程。Docusign 的核心產品 — 我們的智慧協議管理（"IAM"）平台，全球首屈一指的電子簽名解決方案，以及合約生命週期管理（"CLM"）解決方案 — 讓組織提升生產力，加速合約審閱週期，並將協議資料轉化為見解與行動，同時提供以客戶為中心的體驗。Docusign IAM 平台是一套記錄系統，使各規模的客戶都能將大量複雜的協議資料納入單一資料庫，建立可大規模運作的協議流程，並根據協議資料的高準確見解採取行動。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，全球超過 180 萬客戶及超過十億使用者使用 Docusign 來加速並簡化商業流程，且超過 25,000 名客戶目前使用 IAM。
我們向各規模的企業提供產品訂閱服務，從全球企業到非常小的企業（"VSBs"）。我們提供超過 1,100 種活躍的夥伴整合應用，與許多客戶已使用的應用程序相連，使他們能在這些應用程序內直接建立、承諾及管理協議。我們的客戶羣體橫跨幾乎所有產業及全球各地，且無任何重大客戶集中現象。在任一呈報期間，沒有任何單一客戶佔總營收的 10% 以上。

我們最初專注於向商業企業和 VSBs 銷售產品，後來擴展我們的目標至企業客戶。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們總共有超過 180 萬客戶，包括約 28 萬名透過我們銷售團隊及夥伴通路管理的直接企業和商業客戶，與 2025 年 1 月 31 日的近 170 萬客戶及超過 26 萬名直接企業和商業客戶相比。我們將客戶定義為獨立且不同的購買實體，例如公司、教育或政府機構，或大型公司的獨立業務單位，這些實體有活躍的契約以使用我們的產品。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們有 1,205 名客戶的年化契約價值超過 30 萬美元，與 2025 年 1 月 31 日的 1,131 名相比。我們每種客戶類型都有不同的購買新模式。VSBs 通常透過快速使用我們的數位及自服務通路成為客戶，並產生較小的平均契約價值，而商業及企業客戶通常涉及較長的銷售週期、較高的契約價值，以及我們更大的擴張機會。
我們幾乎所有的營收都來自訂閱服務，這在 2026 年 1 月 31 日結止的會計年度中佔營收的 98%，在 2025 年 1 月 31 日結止的會計年度中佔營收的 97%。我們的訂閱費用主要由客戶使用我們的產品及使用客戶支援服務的費用組成。訂閱服務通常為 1 到 3 年，且我們幾乎所有的多年訂閱客戶都以年度分期付款，並在一年前預付。
我們也從專業及其它非訂閱服務中產生營收，主要由為新客戶提供部署及整合服務的費用組成。專業服務及其他營收在 2026 年 1 月 31 日結止的會計年度及 2025 年 1 月 31 日結止的會計年度中，分別佔總營收的剩餘部分。
歷來，我們大多數產品都是以訂閱方式提供，價格根據客戶所需的功能及信封數量而定。與過去用來郵寄紙本文件的實體信封類似，一個信封是一種數位容器，用來傳送一個或多個文件供簽署或批准給一個或多個收件人。我們的客戶有靈活性將大量文件放入一個信封中。對於某些使用案例，例如購屋，會在整個流程中使用多個信封。為了推動客戶的觸及率與採用率，我們也提供某些有限時間或功能受限的電子簽名解決方案免費版本。

在 2025 年財務年度的第二季，我們開始透過我們的直接銷售通路，在特定客戶羣體及地理區域，以用戶為基礎的訂閱方式提供 IAM 平台。在 2026 年財務年度，我們將 IAM 服務擴展至我們營運的所有主要地理區域。我們的 IAM 訂閱服務有數個價格層級，以及針對特定用戶角色、客戶垂直產業及羣體，以及組織內部門的專門包裝。雖然 IAM 訂閱服務包含我們的核心產品與解決方案，例如電子簽名，但我們預期在可見的未來，電子簽名仍將代表我們營收的大多數部分，這是因為 IAM 還處於早期成長階段。在 2026 年 1 月 31 日結止的會計年度中，使用 IAM 的客戶約佔我們年度重複營收的 10.8%。
我們認為我們的市場機會非常大，我們計畫投資以支持長期成長，根據我們長期策略的三個支柱：
第一支柱為透過研究與開發投資加速產品創新，協助我們的 IAM 平台全面解決客戶的協議管理需求。我們的目標是在協議管理市場提供領先的價值，同時朝向平台公司進化。

◦IAM：2024 年 4 月，我們在年度 Momentum 客戶會議上宣佈啟動 IAM 平台。我們從概念到發佈快速創新該平台，並利用客戶反饋。作為一個平台，IAM 包含我們行業領先的 eSignature 產品作為核心能力，並由 Docusign Iris，我們的 AI 引擎所驅動。其他能力包括 Navigator，我們的 AI 維護的協議倉庫，協助客戶管理並從協議中識別見解，以及 Maestro，我們的無碼工作流程建構工具，協助客戶加速協議流程。其他 AI 維護的工具，包括 Agreement Desk、AI 維護的審閱以及 AI 合約代理，可簡化協議的建立與管理。

◦開發者生態系：我們朝向平台公司進化的一部分，需要支援動態的開發者與夥伴社區，以建立延展我們 IAM 平台能力的新解決方案。2024 年 11 月，我們舉辦了 Docusign Discover，這是我們首次以開發者為主的會議，並發佈 Docusing for Developers，為夥伴提供工具以建立由 IAM 平台驅動的應用程式。夥伴可將其應用程式於 Docusign App Center 分享，增加至目前超過 1,100 個活躍的夥伴整合應用程式。
◦eSignature 和 CLM：隨著對產品創新重新聚焦，這些產品已看到創新交付的改善，這是因為我們在 IAM 平台上的投資，使我們的 Docusign 產品組閤中擁有更多 AI 維護的能力。

◦核心價值主張：Docusign 在現有客戶價值主張與好處的基礎上建立 IAM，包括 eSignature 使用的簡易性，已產生超過 775,000 個 Apple App Store 評分，平均評分為 4.9 分（滿分 5 分）；全球足跡與在許多不同法律要求的司法管轄區中客戶的採用情況；高度可稽核的協議與簽名；嚴格的安全認證標準；以及可擴展的基礎設施，使 eSignature 全球可用性達 99.9% 以上。

我們最初專注於向商業企業及 VSBs 銷售產品，後來擴展我們的目標至企業客戶。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們擁有年合約價值超過 30 萬美元的客戶數為 1,205 名，與截至 2025 年 1 月 31 日的 1,131 名相比。我們每種客戶類型均有不同的採購模式。VSBs 通常透過快速使用我們的數位及自服務通路成為客戶，並產生較小的平均合約價值，而商業及企業客戶則通常涉及較長的銷售週期、較高的合約價值及較大的擴張機會。

headings: 與本公司普通股相關的風險
若本公司的 IAM 平台、產品與解決方案無法進化以符合客戶需求，或未能獲得足夠市場接受度，將導致本公司財務表現與競爭地位受損。
快速且難以預測的 AI 及其他科技進步可能降低對我們解決方案的需求，幹擾我們的業務與策略，並造成競爭與財務上的損害。
若我們無法為客戶提供優秀的服務與支援，維持並擴大對現有客戶的銷售，並吸引新客戶，將會對我們的營業收入成長產生負面影響。
我們所參與的市場正在持續演進且競爭激烈，這可能會對我們增加新客戶、維持現有客戶以及拓展業務的能力產生負面影響。
若我們高估了市場機會，未來的成長速度可能會受到限制。
我們在業務中使用 AI，若在正確管理其使用方面遇到困難，可能會造成聲譽損害、競爭損害及法律責任，並對我們的營運成果產生負面影響。
我們依賴高技能人員的表現，包括我們的管理階層及其他關鍵員工，若無法吸引、整合或留住這些員工，可能會對我們的業務造成損害。
我們對政府機構及高度管制組織的銷售面臨許多挑戰與風險。
若我們無法維持與合作夥伴的成功關係，將可能對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成損害。
未能建立並維持與能提供補充性科技產品及軟體整合之合作夥伴關係，可能限制本公司拓展業務之能力。
未能有效開發並擴展行銷與銷售能力，可能影響本公司擴大客戶羣並實現產品與解決方案更廣泛市場接受度之能力。
本公司可能需要降低或調整價格模式以維持競爭力。
本公司可能無法迅速擴展業務以符合客戶日益增長之需求，若無法高效成長，營運成果可能受損。
paragraphs: 這些總結性風險提供許多我們在正常業務運作中所面臨風險的概覽。因此，以下總結性風險並未包含所有對您可能重要的資訊，您應與本節後續標題為『風險因素』的更詳細風險討論，以及本年度報告表10-K中其他資訊一併閱讀。本年度報告表10-K中『風險因素』或其他地方提及的風險，可能有我們目前預期不到或認為不重要的風險，這些風險可能對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況或前景產生不利影響，並可能導致我們普通股的交易價格下跌。
這些風險包括但不限於以下內容：
•任何因eSignature產品的採用或銷售減少，而未能相應提高我們IAM平台其他解決方案的採用或銷售。
•我們的IAM平台未能獲得市場接受度，或未能符合客戶不斷變化的需求。
•因人工智慧及其他技術的進步與應用，導致我們業務、策略及解決方案需求受到幹擾。
•任何無法提供優良的服務與支援給客戶、維持並擴大現有客戶的銷售，以及吸引新客戶的情況。
